title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1982-08-08
lineage: Soundboard cassette-> Reel-> DAT-> CDR-> .WAV-> SHN-> WAV-> SF 5.0 (retrack, d/o fixes)-> CD WAVE-> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 Alpine Valley show with a smoking Scarlet > Fire transition, captured on a clean soundboard transfer that’s missing some bass.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for Jerry Garcia’s incendiary playing and the legendary Scarlet Begonias into Fire segue, plus a soaring Brokedown Palace finale. The soundboard source provides a clear and crisp mix, though reviewers note the bass track is thin or absent in places. Overall the performance is regarded as one of the band’s best from this period.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star ratings highlighting exceptional playing and a clean transfer; only a few note missing bass or give low scores, so the weighted average remains strong.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean soundboard transfer with clear instrument separation; however, the bass is noticeably thin/missing in parts of the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth set flow highlighted by a seamless Scarlet > Fire transition and a strong closing with Brokedown Palace; overall pacing feels tight and energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "on fire" and delivering extended, top‑notch solos throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is reported missing or very weak in the recording.
